_comment: PMOVES.AI Tailscale ACL policy — production hardening stance. Apply at https://login.tailscale.com/admin/acls
_comment_groups: group:tenants = third-party tenant USERS subject to SSH check-mode (browser re-auth) on their own devices. Owner/admins are intentionally excluded so fleet ops never hit re-auth. Empty until tenants enroll (an empty group means the check rule matches no one yet).

acls.comment: Full mesh: all PMOVES nodes can reach each other on all ports
Lab nodes can reach GPU nodes for inference
Partner access: Agent Zero API + UI, TensorZero Gateway only
Guest demo: Agent Zero UI only

Exit node consume: pmoves + lab only. tag:partner and tag:guest intentionally excluded — partner is limited to 3030/8080/8081 and guest to 8081 per RUSTDESK_SELF_HOSTED.md role matrix; granting them full internet egress would be a privilege escalation vs the documented role limits.
DGX Spark: Ollama inference + NIM API
DGX Spark: Lab nodes can access inference
GPU nodes can reach PMOVES mesh services (NATS, Supabase, etc)

Admins + Owner (DARKXSIDE) have full network access. Owner listed explicitly because Tailscale SSH requires BOTH a network-access rule (this) AND an ssh rule; the owner is distinct from autogroup:admin, so without owner here the SSH exemption below is denied at the network layer (port 22 never reached).

ssh.comment: SSH between PMOVES nodes — non-root only for hardening
Admin + Owner SSH (root allowed for provisioning). Owner role is DISTINCT from Admin and must be listed explicitly, else owner SSH falls through to the tenant check rule.

Tenants SSH into their own devices in check mode (browser re-auth). checkPeriod omitted: it is Premium/Enterprise-gated in the policy-syntax reference and the value we wanted (12h) is already the default, so omitting it preserves behavior while keeping the policy applyable on Standard/free tailnets. Scoped to group:tenants, NOT autogroup:member, because Tailscale evaluates check BEFORE accept (most-restrictive-first, regardless of rule order) — so excluding owner/admins from this src is the only way to exempt fleet ops from re-auth.

nodeAttrs.comment: Exit nodes can use Tailscale Funnel for public ingress
